children: The AstralBeam cross-chain bridge is scheduled to go live on Casper mainnet, connecting the network with Ethereum, Base, Polygon, and Robinhood Chain. The launch establishes a direct asset route between Casper and four established chains.

A working bridge changes how value reaches the Casper ecosystem. Connections to Ethereum, Base, Polygon, and Robinhood Chain open a channel for tokenized equities, metals, and other regulated real-world assets to flow toward Casper applications, giving CSPR a concrete new demand path rather than a purely speculative one.

The practical effect depends on adoption after launch. Bridge volume, the range of supported assets, and how much real-world asset activity actually routes through AstralBeam will determine whether the connection translates into sustained usage for the network.
